caption: The drawing features a single green-tinted goblet positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The goblet has a round bowl, a short stem with a circular knop, and a wide, flat base. The goblet is depicted in a realistic style, with visible highlights and shading that suggest its glassy, translucent material. The edges and contours are defined with darker lines, and the green color varies in intensity to indicate thickness and light reflection. There are no other objects or decorative elements on the beige canvas, and the artist’s signature, “A. KARLIN,” appears in small text near the lower right corner.
title: Wine Glass
